def save_note(path, text, append=False):
    mode = "a" if append else "w"
    with open(path, mode, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return handle.write(text)

print(save_note("demo-note.txt", "Sky\n"))
print(save_note("demo-note.txt", "Moon\n", append=True))
with open("demo-note.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    print(repr(handle.read()))

def parse_minutes(arguments):

import argparse

def parse_minutes(arguments):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="study", add_help=False, allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("--minutes", type=int, default=10, choices=range(1, 61))
    options = parser.parse_args(arguments)
    return options.minutes

try:
    print(parse_minutes(["--minutes", "61"]))
except SystemExit as error:
    print(error.code)
print(parse_minutes([]))
